description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - The Customs Ordinance Under Section 19 A.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns a legal/regulatory matter - specifically, an order issued under Section 19(A) of the Customs Ordinance that grants exemptions from customs import duties. It establishes regulatory frameworks for duty waivers, specifies conditions for compliance, and outlines the legal authority (Customs Ordinance) under which the Minister is acting. The content focuses on regulatory compliance requirements and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
